You can use magic runes to enhance your gear. You learn two runes of your choice from those below, and each time you gain a Fighter level, you can replace one rune you know with another. You learn more runes at certain Fighter levels, as shown in the Runes Known table.

Fighter LevelRunes Known
32
73
104
155

Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can touch a number of objects equal to the number of runes you know and inscribe a different rune on each. To be eligible, an object must be a weapon, a suit of armor, a Shield, a piece of jewelry, or something else you can wear or hold in a hand. A rune remains on an object until you finish a Long Rest, and an object can bear only one of your runes at a time. If a rune requires a saving throw, your Rune Magic save DC equals 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus.

Runes: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.SKUPx8AJZbyOzQQq]{Cloud Rune}, @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.xVr5TZau1HOZRFyB]{Fire Rune}, @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.Aj77HlVVYBuZfGPs]{Frost Rune}, @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.Yh5G0BITj07ABCLv]{Stone Rune}, @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.MUXmawyL3cd8768K]{Hill Rune} (Fighter level 7+), @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.P2bDLf15BUQMMwE5]{Storm Rune} (Fighter level 7+).
